Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.

In pursuance of earlier order dated 09.08.2023, Shri Sandeep Kumar (S.I.) and Akhilesh Kumar Pandey (S.I.), Investigating Officers of the case in question are present along with the complete instructions and informed that the charge sheet has already been filed.

Their presence is hereby dispensed with and they need not to appear before this Court till further order.
2.
Heard learned counsel for the revisionist, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

3. Present application is moved by the revisionist to quash the entire proceeding of session trial no.
346 of 2022 titled as state versus Lalit Tiari alias Chandan, related to case crime no.95 of 2022,
under sections 363, 376 I.P.C. & 3/4 POCSO Act P.S. Gilola, District- Shrawasti, pending before learned Additional Session Judge (F.T.C.)/Special Judge offences against women, Shrawasti.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the revisionist submitted that the revisionist is an innocent person and has been falsely implicated in the present case by the private respondent with the allegation that on 17.07.2022 at about 9:30 PM, minor daughter (aged about of 14 years) of the private respondent was enticed away by the revisionist with the association of co-accused Rajan s/o Vijay Kumar Tiwari,
Lavkush Tiwari s/o Dileep Kumar and Vimal Tiwari s/o Brijesh Tiwari residents of the same village and the victim was recovered from the house of Vimal Tiwari, thereafter, F.I.R. was lodged and victim was medically examined.

He further submitted that in the radio-logical examination, age of victim was found to be 17 years and on the basis of fabricated documents, victim was declared as minor and charge sheet was filed by the Investigating Officer on 17.09.2022 for the offences under Sections 363, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 of POCSO Act.

He further submitted that cognizance was taken by the Special Court, POCSO Act on 15.10.2022, and thereafter, on the request of revisionist, further investigation of the case in question was conducted, in which, the victim was found to be major,
thereafter, supplementary charge sheet was submitted by the Investigating Officer on 15.03.2023 under Sections 366, 376 and Sections 363 I.P.C., and 3/4 of POCSO Act were deleted but the Court below failed to take cognizance on the supplementary charge sheet.
5. Learned counsel for the revisionist relied on the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Vinay Tyagi Vs. Irshad Ali @ Deepak and Others reported in (2013) 5 SCC 762 and submitted that it is obligatory on the part of Court below to take cognizance on the supplementary charge sheet, as the application was moved by the revisionist before the Court below for taking cognizance on the supplementary police report dated 15.03.2023 but the same was rejected.

entities.text: Vinay Tyagi Vs. Irshad Ali @ Deepak and Others reported in (2013) 5 SCC 762
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that further investigation was conducted on the request of revisionist and charges were framed on the basis of first charge-sheet then the revisionist moved an application before the court below for taking cognizance also on the supplementary charge-sheet and requested that charges may be altered on the basis of supplementary charge sheet as the victim was found major but the application of revisionist was rejected, therefore, kind indulgence of this Court is necessary.
6. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer of revisionist and submitted that charge can be altered at any stage.

He further submitted that cognizance was taken on the supplementary charge sheet as the Court below, at this stage, does not find appropriate to alter the charges which were already framed for the offences under Sections 363, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 of POCSO Act.

He further submitted that version of the revisionist can be considered at the appropriate stage and charges can be altered at any stage after adducing the evidences from either side, therefore, there is no illegality on the part of the Court below and the application of revisionist is liable to be dismissed.

7. Considering the submissions of counsel for the parties, going through the contents of revision, as well as other relevant documents, as it is evident that charge-sheet dated 17.09.2022 was filed for the offences under Sections 363, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 of POCSO Act on the basis of statement of victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. as well as other relevant documents including documents related to the age of victim, and thereafter, on the request of the revisionist, further investigation was conducted by the Investigating Officer and in the investigation, it was found that victim was major at the time of alleged incident, therefore, supplementary charge sheet was submitted and Section 363 I.P.C., and 3/4 of POCSO were deleted.
As the charges were already framed for the offences under Sections 363, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 of POCSO Act, Court below did not Lalit Tiwari @ Chandan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...

2 find it appropriate to alter the charges on the basis of supplementary charge sheet, therefore,
application was moved by the revisionist for alteration of the charges and the same was rejected by the Court below as charges can be altered at any stage after adducing the evidences from both the sides and at this stage, there is no illegality in the order passed by the Court below, therefore, this Court is of the view that the present revision is misconceived and liable to be dismissed.
8.
Hence, the revision is hereby dismissed.
